title: Save admin transcript edits and evidence reviews
summary: Download your saved staging transcripts and evidence reviews, then commit and push their JSON files to Git.

steps.title: Get the latest staging branch
steps.note: Start with a clean working tree. If git status shows your own unfinished changes, commit them before switching or pulling. Stop if any command fails.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git switch staging &&
git pull --ff-only origin staging

steps.title: Download both kinds of admin edits
steps.note: Save changes in the browser first. calls-from-db downloads transcripts and verified flags; evidence-from-db downloads all evidence groups, notes, confirmations and deletion history.
steps.commands:
make calls-from-db &&
make evidence-from-db

steps.title: Review the downloaded JSON
steps.note: Review the status and diff summary before copying the next panel. If there are no changes, skip the commit and push.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git diff --stat

steps.title: Commit the reviewed JSON files
steps.commands:
git add -- data public/records/openmhz &&
git commit -m "Save staging radio edits and evidence reviews" &&
git push origin staging

title: Upload changed source JSON to the staging database
summary: Use after changing roster data, archive settings or other JSON-managed data. Download admin edits before editing the files.

steps.title: Get the latest staging branch
steps.note: Start with a clean working tree; preserve unfinished local changes first.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git switch staging &&
git pull --ff-only origin staging

steps.title: Preserve the current admin edits
steps.note: Do this before editing the source JSON. calls-from-db replaces local transcript values with the database values. If you already edited transcripts locally, reconcile those edits before downloading.
steps.commands:
make calls-from-db &&
make evidence-from-db

steps.title: Edit the JSON, then upload to staging
steps.note: Pause here to make your intended JSON changes. db-upload currently recreates the JSON-managed database tables, including transcripts. It preserves the separate evidence tables and does not import the evidence snapshot.
steps.commands: make db-upload

steps.title: Review the changes
steps.note: Check the edited source JSON before continuing. If there are no Git changes, skip the commit and push.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git diff --stat

steps.title: Commit and push the reviewed JSON
steps.commands:
git add -- data public/records/openmhz &&
git commit -m "Update staging source data" &&
git push origin staging

title: Save only the evidence review data
summary: Download reviewed and unreviewed groups, then save the evidence snapshot in Git.

steps.title: Get the latest staging branch
steps.note: Start with a clean working tree and save your browser edits first.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git switch staging &&
git pull --ff-only origin staging

steps.title: Download every evidence group
steps.note: Writes data/db-evidenence-associations.json, including empty groups, notes, speaker confirmations, original sources and deletion records. Identical data produces identical JSON.
steps.commands: make evidence-from-db

steps.title: Review the exported file
steps.note: This snapshot includes correction notes and will be public when pushed to this repository. If there are no changes, skip the next panel.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git diff --stat -- data/db-evidenence-associations.json

steps.title: Commit and push the snapshot
steps.commands:
git add -- data/db-evidenence-associations.json &&
git commit -m "Save staging evidence review snapshot" &&
git push origin staging

title: Edit or restore the evidence snapshot to staging
summary: An explicit evidence upload. Represented groups receive the file’s notes, clip selections and confirmation flags.

steps.title: Get the latest staging branch
steps.note: Start with a clean working tree. Keep any intended restore file separately so the next download does not replace your only copy.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git switch staging &&
git pull --ff-only origin staging

steps.title: Download the current evidence before editing
steps.note: Then edit data/db-evidenence-associations.json, or replace it with the snapshot you intentionally want to restore. Keep stable IDs intact. Do not download again until you have uploaded those intended edits.
steps.commands: make evidence-from-db

steps.title: Upload the intended file, then download the saved result
steps.note: evidence-to-db backs up staging evidence under db/local/ and rehearses the upload first. Existing group revisions advance. Unrepresented groups remain unless a deletion record explicitly removes them. Recordings and transcripts are preserved.
steps.commands:
make evidence-to-db &&
make evidence-from-db

steps.title: Review the saved result
steps.note: If there are no Git changes, skip the next panel. The admin page reads the saved database values directly.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git diff --stat -- data/db-evidenence-associations.json

steps.title: Commit and push the saved snapshot
steps.commands:
git add -- data/db-evidenence-associations.json &&
git commit -m "Update staging evidence review snapshot" &&
git push origin staging

title: Recreate the JSON-managed staging tables
summary: A repair workflow for staging. Downloads admin edits first; the separate evidence tables are retained.

steps.title: Get the latest staging branch
steps.note: Start with a clean working tree.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git switch staging &&
git pull --ff-only origin staging

steps.title: Preserve edits, then reset
steps.note: db-reset creates a staging backup and recreates JSON-managed rows from the local source files. It retains evidence reviews. The current db-upload policy also recreates all JSON-managed tables.
steps.commands:
make calls-from-db &&
make evidence-from-db &&
make db-reset

steps.title: Review the preserved files
steps.note: If there are no Git changes, skip the commit and push.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git diff --stat

steps.title: Commit and push the reviewed JSON
steps.commands:
git add -- data public/records/openmhz &&
git commit -m "Preserve staging data before database reset" &&
git push origin staging

title: Promote the staging database to production
summary: Copies the entire staging database, including evidence reviews, to production. This separate production action does not back up the previous production database.

steps.title: Get the latest staging code
steps.note: Start with a clean working tree and finish saving admin edits in the browser. The promotion copies a snapshot of the live staging database; it does not upload the local JSON first.
steps.commands:
git status --short &&
git switch staging &&
git pull --ff-only origin staging

steps.title: Replace the production database with staging
steps.note: This is the only database Make command that writes to production. It retains a staging snapshot under db/local/ and does not back up the previous production database. No source or target database argument is accepted.
steps.commands: make promote-db
